For many people the main problem is loose skin, like “I won’t start because I’ll end up with loose skin.” But the reality is a bit different. I lost 101lbs over two years, and I have zero loose skin. Let me explain why.

If you start early you have perfect conditions due to the high levels of Collagen and Elastin, BUT only if you do it gradually. Lose weight too fast and your age simply doesn’t matter, you’re going to end up with loose skin anyway. Even your mid 30s give you a great chance to end up with no loose skin if the process is gradual, but the speed of adaptation slows down**.**

When you are young the biology is working in your favour, so don’t wait until it’s too late. 

Has the fear of loose skin ever held you back from starting?
